label: Friendly
summary: Warm, empathetic, and approachable conversational voice
Welcoming language that builds community rapport
writing_style: Conversational, engaging prose with natural sentence flow and helpful explanations.
messaging_principles: Connect with readers warmly and offer proactive assistance at every stage.

rules.title: Avoid Cold Bureaucratic Distance
rules.description: Friendly communications should replace distant bureaucratic phrasing with welcoming language.

suggested_replacements.parties are severally bound: our agreement outlines our mutual commitment
suggested_replacements.failure to comply will result in immedia: let us know if you need assistance meeting this deadline

rules.do_example: We are here to support your team whenever you have questions.
rules.dont_example: The undersigned hereby commands all users to comply or face forfeiture.

terminology.preferred: reach out to our friendly team
